#include <string>

    std::string s;
    std::getline(std::cin, s);
    
    int count = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); ) {
        int j = i + 1;
        while (j < s.length() && s[j] == s[i]) {
            j++;
        }
        if (((j - i) & 1) == 0) {
            count++;
        }
        i = j;
    }
    std::cout << count << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
